limitations: OSM is a collaborative map. These administrative boundaries have not been reconciled against officially certified boundaries.
The lake polygon is a conventional outline; survey year and observed water level are unavailable.

The input contains 153 river features (87 unnamed, 66 named). The upstream inventory describes a different file containing 134 named river features. Per-feature OSM IDs and versions are traceable; the original full-network query and exact extraction time are unavailable.

Only four county/district polygons are provided. Surrounding white space does not mean unadministered land or water. Higher-level names are placed within the supplied members and do not imply complete province/city boundaries.
River lines follow the open dataset. Hydrologic flow direction and network completeness have not been verified; no flow arrows are drawn.
processing: The original private development inputs were preserved during initial preparation. They are identified by their recorded hashes; this public edition contains translated derived working files.

Initial preparation copied three GeoJSON files without geometry changes. The public English edition translates names and descriptive attributes, removes duplicate non-English tags and editor usernames, and preserves all geometry coordinates and OSM object IDs.
The renderer clips to the display extent and transforms EPSG:4326 to the selected UTM projection. A display mask hides river portions overlapping the Shijiu Lake polygon.
The province boundary is derived only from exact shared edges of the supplied Jiangsu/Anhui county/district polygons. Every administrative label denotes an area, not a government seat.

english_edition.name_policy: Proper names are transliterated into pinyin and generic feature-type words are translated into English. These working labels are not certified official English names.
english_edition.source_sha256_meaning: Hashes of original development snapshots; working_sha256 identifies translated public files.
changes: Removed duplicate original-language tags and per-edit usernames/user IDs; aggregate OSM attribution and object provenance remain.
Kept coordinates, OSM object IDs, edit versions and source URLs unchanged.
